fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone ahead of you, dealing 8 damage to everything in it and stunning it for 0.8 seconds, and making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lingering Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a stinking glob that deals 4 damage and has a 30% chance of [Hindered] for 4 seconds, slowing the target's attacks.

fusions.name: Left Alone
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Stink of Warning
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, a stinking bolt hits the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 40 seconds.
